verdict.rationale: A live probe of HMRC's production API platform returned a structured ACCEPT_HEADER_INVALID error and was characterised as a versioned REST platform, which gives thin evidence that the APIs are versioned. No deprecation policy appears anywhere in the pack, because the developer hub documentation was blocked by robots.txt and not fetched. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, first-party API versioning documentation, sunset/retirement timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: a live, versioned production REST platform (Making Tax Digital) answering with a structured error contract
